nameZh: 台达 Delta ESR-48/56AC 高效开关电源整流模块 (-48V 56A 3000W)
nameEn: Delta ESR-48/56AC High-Efficiency Switch-Mode Telecom Rectifier Module (-48V 56A 3000W)
directDefZh: 台达 ESR-48/56AC 是一款标称输出 -48V、最大额定电流 56A、额定功率 3000W 的电信级高频开关整流器模块，采用宽交流电压输入范围与先进数字软开关拓扑。
directDefEn: The Delta ESR-48/56AC is a carrier-grade high-frequency switch-mode telecom rectifier module delivering nominal -48V DC, 56A maximum output current, and 3000W rated power across a wide AC input voltage range.
shortDescZh: 台达 ESR-48/56AC -48V 56A 3000W 高效通信开关整流器模块，支持宽温运行与热插拔。
shortDescEn: Delta ESR-48/56AC -48V 56A 3000W telecom rectifier module with wide temperature support and hot-swap capability.
whatItIsZh: 该模块嵌入于台达通信直流电源插框系统中，负责将外部市电或油机单相交流电高效平稳转换为低纹波 -48V 直流动力电，为基站主设备持续供电并为蓄电池浮充供电。
whatItIsEn: This module slots into Delta telecom DC power subracks, converting incoming single-phase utility or generator AC power into low-ripple -48V DC power to drive base station equipment and charge backup batteries.
problemSolvedZh: 解决传统老旧整流器转换效率低下、输入谐波失真大以及电网骤降导致基站保护断电等痛点，提供高功率因数与极高电网适应性。
problemSolvedEn: Eliminates low power conversion efficiency, high input harmonic distortion, and nuisance tripping during utility voltage sags, ensuring high power factor and grid tolerance.
suitableForZh: 适用于电信运营商无线基站、微波传输局站、中心机房直流屏以及各类部署台达电源系统的工业供电场景。
suitableForEn: Engineered for wireless macro cell sites, microwave transmission hubs, core switching offices, and industrial power distribution systems utilizing Delta subracks.
advantagesZh: 高能效转换输出：典型转换效率超过 92%，有效削减机房电费支出与散热制冷功耗。
超宽交流输入范围：支持 88V~300V AC 宽压输入，适应复杂恶劣农村与偏远海岛电网工况。
无损热插拔维护：支持带电在线插拔，更换或扩容无需切断直流母线供电，保障通信零中断。
智能数字均流协同：支持多模块自主均流与并联冗余，单模块故障不影响整体系统持续运行。
advantagesEn: High-Efficiency Power Conversion: Typical efficiency exceeds 92%, substantially reducing site utility costs and cooling requirements.
Ultra-Wide AC Input Range: Operates reliably across 88V to 300V AC, withstanding severe grid voltage drops in remote regions.
Hitless Hot-Plug Maintenance: Supports live insertion and removal without interrupting continuous -48V DC bus power delivery.
Active Digital Current Sharing: Autonomous load sharing across multiple parallel modules ensures uninterrupted N+1 redundancy.

attributes.valZh: 智能温控风冷 / 嵌入式热插拔

faqsZh.q: ESR-48/56AC 模块插入机架后无直流输出，面板指示灯无反应，应如何排查？
faqsZh.a: 首先使用万用表测量机架背板交流输入插座是否有正常交流电压（88V~300V AC）。若输入正常，请检查模块插入力度是否完全到位、插针是否对齐。若模块仍未上电，请检查模块内部交流进线熔丝是否烧断。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 模块在重载运行一段时间后面板过温告警黄灯亮起，是什么原因？
faqsZh.a: 这通常表明模块内部散热风道受阻或机房进风口灰尘滤网积灰严重。建议断电拔出模块，使用压缩空气清理风扇叶片与内部铝散热片，并确认机房室内空调温度在 25℃ 正常区间。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 多块 ESR-48/56AC 模块并联工作时电流分配不均，该如何校准？
faqsZh.a: 请检查机架背板的均流通信互联引脚是否接触良好，或模块输出电压设定值是否存在微小偏差。可通过监控单元重新下发统一浮充电压参数。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to troubleshoot when ESR-48/56AC has no DC output and LEDs remain unlit after insertion?
faqsEn.a: Verify incoming AC voltage at the backplane connector using a multimeter (88V to 300V AC). If input power is normal, ensure the module is fully pushed into the subrack and latched. Inspect internal input fuses if symptoms persist. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: What causes the over-temperature alarm LED to illuminate under heavy operational load?
faqsEn.a: This indicates airflow blockage or heavy dust accumulation on the cooling fan and internal heatsinks. Clean the airflow passages using compressed air and verify ambient room temperature is maintained below 25°C. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to correct unequal load current sharing across parallel ESR-48/56AC modules?
faqsEn.a: Inspect the current-share bus pins on the backplane for corrosion or loose contacts. Re-calibrate or align individual module float voltage presets through the system supervisory controller. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

nameZh: 台达 Delta ESR-48/56BC 宽温通信开关整流器模块 (-48V 56A 3000W)
nameEn: Delta ESR-48/56BC Wide-Temperature Telecom Switch-Mode Rectifier Module (-48V 56A 3000W)
directDefZh: 台达 ESR-48/56BC 是一款适用于户外与宽温恶劣环境的 48V 56A 高可靠性通信开关整流器模块，额定输出 3000W，具备完善的防雷浪涌抑制能力。
directDefEn: The Delta ESR-48/56BC is a ruggedized 48V 56A high-reliability telecom switch-mode rectifier module rated at 3000W, engineered for extreme temperatures and featuring enhanced surge immunity.
shortDescZh: 台达 ESR-48/56BC -48V 56A 3000W 宽温高效通信整流模块，专为户外站址与严苛电网打造。
shortDescEn: Delta ESR-48/56BC -48V 56A 3000W ruggedized telecom rectifier module designed for outdoor cabinets and harsh grid environments.
whatItIsZh: 该模块主要配装于台达各类室外机柜及室内通信电源屏中，为通信负荷提供高纯净度 -48V 直流电源，具备优秀的抗雷击和输入过欠压自我保护特性。
whatItIsEn: This unit is primarily deployed within Delta outdoor enclosures and indoor telecom power racks, providing high-purity -48V DC power with superior lightning surge immunity.
problemSolvedZh: 解决户外基站夏季高温暴晒、电网易受雷击浪涌冲击导致整流模块损坏停机的行业痛点，保障户外无人值守站点的高可用度。
problemSolvedEn: Solves outdoor base station vulnerabilities such as extreme ambient heat and grid lightning surges causing premature rectifier failure, ensuring high uptime for unattended sites.
suitableForZh: 适用于 4G/5G 室外一体化机柜、野外边防哨所通信站、高速公路沿线监控供电以及变电站自动化通信电源。
suitableForEn: Engineered for 4G/5G outdoor integrated cabinets, remote border station towers, highway surveillance power systems, and utility substation communications.
advantagesZh: 严苛宽温环境耐受：支持 -40℃ 至 +75℃ 极限宽温运行，高温达 55℃ 仍能保持 100% 满功率输出。
工业级高等级防雷：交流输入端强化集成浪涌防护电路，耐受高达 6kV 差模与共模雷击冲击。
全数字智能微控：内置 DSP 微处理器，精确控制输出均流、动态响应时间与输入谐波含量。
超高功率密度紧凑化：精简机框占用体积，为机架预留更多电池与通信主设备安装空间。
advantagesEn: Extreme Temperature Tolerance: Operates reliably from -40°C to +75°C, sustaining 100% full rated power up to 55°C ambient.
Enhanced Lightning Surge Immunity: Integrated multi-stage surge protection circuit withstands up to 6kV common and differential mode transients.
Advanced Digital DSP Control: Embedded DSP delivers precise autonomous load-sharing, sub-millisecond dynamic response, and low THD.
High Power Density Compact Footprint: Optimizes subrack space, maximizing room for backup batteries and transmission hardware.

faqsZh.q: ESR-48/56BC 模块与 ESR-48/56AC 有何区别，能否在同一机框中混插混用？
faqsZh.a: ESR-48/56BC 为强化宽温与高防雷版本，电气接口与机械外形保持兼容，可在台达同系列插框中无损替换。但为确保多模块均流精度与最佳温控一致性，建议同一系统尽量保持同一批次或型号并联运行。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 雷雨天气后模块出现红灯告警并停止输出，应如何处理？
faqsZh.a: 请先断开前端输入断路器并拔出模块，检查防雷 MOV 是否击穿、输入保险丝是否断开。若外部防雷器完好，重新插拔并合闸尝试自愈。若内部器件损坏，请更换备用模块。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 模块在极寒地区（如零下30℃）冬季启动时是否有预热延迟？
faqsZh.a: ESR-48/56BC 原生支持 -40℃ 极限冷启动，内部控温芯片具备低温自适应软启动特性，上电 3 秒内即可平稳建立额定输出电压。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: What is the difference between ESR-48/56BC and ESR-48/56AC, and can they be intermixed?
faqsEn.a: The ESR-48/56BC is an enhanced ruggedized model featuring wider temperature range and 6kV surge immunity. Form factor and pinouts are mechanically compatible, but for optimal current sharing, running identical models in parallel is recommended. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to handle a red alarm LED and shutdown following a severe thunderstorm?
faqsEn.a: Disconnect the AC breaker and remove the module. Inspect for blown input fuses or thermal damage on internal surge arrestors. Re-seat and restore AC power; if failure persists, replace with a verified spare unit. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: Does the module require pre-heating when cold-started at -30°C in winter?
faqsEn.a: No pre-heating is required. The ESR-48/56BC supports native cold-starts down to -40°C, smoothly ramping up to full rated DC voltage within 3 seconds. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

nameZh: 台达 Delta ESR-48/50DE 超高效通信电源整流模块 (-48V 50A >96%能效)
nameEn: Delta ESR-48/50DE Ultra-High Efficiency Telecom Switch-Mode Rectifier Module (-48V 50A >96% Efficiency)
directDefZh: 台达 ESR-48/50DE 是一款具备超 96% 峰值转换效率的绿色节能型通信整流器，额定输出 -48V 50A（最大功率 2900W），采用数字化谐振软开关与智能休眠节能架构。
directDefEn: The Delta ESR-48/50DE is a green energy-saving telecom rectifier module achieving over 96% peak conversion efficiency, delivering -48V 50A (up to 2900W) with digital resonant soft-switching technology.
shortDescZh: 台达 ESR-48/50DE -48V 50A 超 96% 能效绿色通信整流模块，显著降低基站 PUE 与运营能耗。
shortDescEn: Delta ESR-48/50DE -48V 50A telecom rectifier delivering >96% peak efficiency to dramatically reduce site PUE and power loss.
whatItIsZh: 作为台达新一代高效电源系统的核心部件，该模块将交流电转换为电信级纯净稳压直流电，其卓越的能效表现可将电力转换损耗降低 50% 以上。
whatItIsEn: As the core energy engine of Delta modern telecom power systems, this module converts AC power into telecom-grade stabilized DC, cutting conversion power losses by over 50%.
problemSolvedZh: 帮助运营商与数据中心降低 PUE 指标，减少传统整流器高发热量导致的精密空调负荷，大幅度节省全生命周期电费与运维开支。
problemSolvedEn: Helps telecom operators and data centers lower PUE, significantly cuts waste heat generation to reduce cooling overhead, and lowers total cost of ownership (TCO).
suitableForZh: 广泛应用于 5G 绿色节能基站、IDC 边缘计算微数据中心、电信核心局房改造以及高密度机架供电系统。
suitableForEn: Widely deployed in green 5G cell sites, edge micro data centers, central office energy retrofits, and high-density telecom power racks.
advantagesZh: 行业领先转换效率：峰值效率突破 96.2% 以上，处于国际一级能效水准，显著削减热损耗。
智能模块休眠调度：支持系统控制器统一多模块调度，在轻载时自动关停冗余模块保持最高效率运行。
高功率因数低谐波：输入功率因数 >0.99，THD 谐波失真 <5%，对供电电网与前级油机无污染。
全热插拔极简维护：符合通用标准插框导轨，单人 10 秒内即可完成现场在线更换或带电扩容。
advantagesEn: Industry-Leading Peak Efficiency: Peak efficiency exceeds 96.2%, meeting top-tier global green energy standards and minimizing heat dissipation.
Smart Multi-Unit Hibernation: Supports intelligent supervisory sleep cycling to keep active rectifiers operating at peak efficiency points.
High PF and Low Harmonics: Power factor >0.99 and THD <5%, preventing harmonic pollution to upstream transformers and generators.
Effortless Hot-Swap Capability: Standard guide-rail mechanism enables single-technician replacement within 10 seconds without site downtime.

attributes.valZh: 变速低噪风扇 / 19英寸插框热插拔

faqsZh.q: ESR-48/50DE 在轻载（例如 20%~30% 负载）时的转换效率表现如何？
faqsZh.a: 得益于台达先进的数字谐振变换技术，ESR-48/50DE 在 20% 负载下仍能保持 94% 以上的极高效率，平坦的效率曲线确保基站在夜间轻载时同样具备出色的节能表现。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 如何开启和配合系统控制器的‘智能模块休眠节能’功能？
faqsZh.a: 在台达 CSU 监控单元设置菜单中开启‘Eco Mode / 休眠轮巡’功能，控制器会根据全站实时直流负载电流动态唤醒或休眠整流模块，定期轮换休眠对象以均衡模块寿命。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 风扇出现转速降低或异响是否支持独立维修或更换？
faqsZh.a: 支持。该模块风扇采用模块化插拔接头设计，断电拔出模块后拆除前侧保护罩即可快速更换原厂配套低噪温控直流风扇。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How does ESR-48/50DE perform under light operational loads (e.g., 20% to 30%)?
faqsEn.a: Thanks to digital resonant topology, the ESR-48/50DE maintains >94% efficiency even at 20% load, ensuring flat, optimal energy savings during off-peak nighttime telecom traffic. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to configure and operate the smart rectifier hibernation energy-saving mode?
faqsEn.a: Enable 'Eco Mode / Hibernation Cycling' in the Delta CSU controller. The controller monitors DC load current, dynamically resting redundant rectifiers while periodically cycling units to balance service life. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: Can the internal cooling fan be replaced independently if bearing wear occurs?
faqsEn.a: Yes. The internal fan uses a modular connector harness. After removing the unit and front bezel, the genuine DC fan assembly can be quickly swapped out. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

nameZh: 台达 Delta ESR-48/40AC 紧凑型高频开关整流器 (-48V 40A 2000W)
nameEn: Delta ESR-48/40AC Compact Switch-Mode Telecom Rectifier Module (-48V 40A 2000W)
directDefZh: 台达 ESR-48/40AC 是一款额定输出 -48V 40A（最大功率 2000W）的高可靠紧凑型整流模块，专为机柜空间受限的接入网站点及小型通信机房打造。
directDefEn: The Delta ESR-48/40AC is a compact telecom rectifier module delivering -48V 40A (2000W max power), engineered for space-constrained access network sites and micro telecom shelters.
shortDescZh: 台达 ESR-48/40AC -48V 40A 2000W 紧凑型通信整流器，机框浅深度设计，支持热插拔与灵活扩容。
shortDescEn: Delta ESR-48/40AC -48V 40A 2000W compact telecom rectifier with short depth for tight enclosure installations.
whatItIsZh: 该模块安装于台达 1U/2U 或中小型嵌入式电源插框内，将常规单相交流电转换为电信级稳定的直流电力，是小型站点动力系统的中流砥柱。
whatItIsEn: This unit installs into Delta 1U/2U or compact embedded power subracks, converting single-phase AC into telecom-grade stabilized DC for micro station power systems.
problemSolvedZh: 解决浅深度机柜无法安装大型整流器、小型偏远站址维护不便以及电网波动导致的频繁保护停机等问题。
problemSolvedEn: Solves space limitation in shallow outdoor enclosures, remote maintenance difficulties, and premature shutdowns caused by unstable utility voltages.
suitableForZh: 适用于 4G/5G 微基站、光纤分纤接入机房、铁路信号中继站以及各类嵌入式工业控制设备。
suitableForEn: Engineered for 4G/5G small cells, FTTH optical distribution hubs, railway signaling relay boxes, and industrial embedded power supplies.
advantagesZh: 浅深度紧凑化机身：机身纵深短、重量轻，适合紧凑型壁挂箱与浅深室外机柜安装部署。
宽电网环境自适应：支持 85V~300V AC 超宽工作区间，输入低至 90VAC 仍可降额稳定工作。
热插拔与智能均流：即插即拔无电弧设计，模块间自主并联自动均流，单机故障不影响系统。
电信级低噪声设计：内部风道经过声学优化，满载运行时噪声极低，符合城市住宅区基站标准。
advantagesEn: Compact Shallow-Depth Chassis: Reduced depth and light weight facilitate mounting in tight wall-mount boxes and shallow outdoor enclosures.
Wide Utility Grid Adaptability: Operates from 85V to 300V AC, continuing to deliver stable derated power down to 90VAC input.
Arc-Free Hot-Swap & Current Sharing: Plug-and-play design with autonomous parallel load-sharing prevents single-point system outages.
Low Acoustic Noise Profile: Acoustically optimized airflow path ensures ultra-quiet operation compliant with urban residential site requirements.

attributes.valZh: 智能直流风冷 / 浅深度热插拔

faqsZh.q: ESR-48/40AC 在交流输入电压偏低（如低于 176V）时输出性能如何？
faqsZh.a: 模块具备输入欠压线性降额保护功能，当交流输入在 85V~176V 之间时，模块依然持续稳定输出，输出电流按比例安全降额，确保基站重要业务绝不中断。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 模块如何设置输出电压（浮充电压与均充电压）？
faqsZh.a: 在插框系统中，模块输出电压受后台 CSU 监控单元数字总线统一自动调谐；在无监控单机工作模式下，出厂默认预设为标准电信浮充电压 -53.5V。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 如何判断模块内部过流保护还是风扇故障？
faqsZh.a: 若面板只有红灯常亮且无输出，通常为输出短路或过压保护；若黄灯常亮伴随风扇停转，则为散热风扇停转或过温保护，可通过上位机监控读取精确告警代码。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How does the ESR-48/40AC perform when AC input voltage drops below 176V?
faqsEn.a: The unit features automatic linear undervoltage derating. Between 85V and 176V AC, it delivers continuous DC power with proportional current derating to prevent site outage. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How are the float and equalize output voltages adjusted on this module?
faqsEn.a: In subrack systems, voltages are regulated dynamically via the CSU controller bus. In standalone mode without a controller, the module operates at factory-preset -53.5V float voltage. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to differentiate between an internal overcurrent trip and a cooling fan failure?
faqsEn.a: A solid red LED indicates output short-circuit or overvoltage lockout. A solid yellow LED paired with a stopped fan indicates fan fault or thermal protection. Confirm exact alarm codes on the supervisory screen. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to diagnose repeated AC input fuse failures on this module?

faqsEn.a: Verify DC operating supply voltage from the subrack backplane (-36V to -72V DC). Inspect alignment of rear interface connector pins and ensure the locking thumbscrews are firmly seated. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to configure low-voltage disconnect thresholds (LLVD & BLVD) on this unit?
faqsEn.a: Press 'Ent' to access the main menu, enter the engineer passcode, navigate to 'Battery Settings', and configure LLVD (typically 45.0V) and BLVD (typically 43.2V) threshold values. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to restore supervisory communications if the central NMS loses connection?
faqsEn.a: Check physical Ethernet or RS485 cabling for loose connections. Verify communication baud rate, device ID address, and network IP settings match the upstream OSS configuration. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

nameZh: 中兴 ZTE ZXDU68 T601 落地式通信高频直流电源柜 (-48V 600A大容量)
nameEn: ZTE ZXDU68 T601 Floor-Standing Telecommunications DC Power Cabinet (-48V 600A High Capacity)
directDefZh: 中兴 ZXDU68 T601 是一款大容量、高可靠性的落地柜式通信直流供电系统，额定直流输出 -48V 600A，配备一体化交流配电、大电流整流插框、直流分配支路及智能 CSU 监控系统。
directDefEn: The ZTE ZXDU68 T601 is a high-capacity floor-standing telecom DC power plant delivering -48V 600A, integrating AC distribution, high-efficiency rectifier shelves, DC distribution breakers, and a central CSU supervisor.
shortDescZh: 中兴 ZXDU68 T601 落地柜式 -48V 600A 大容量通信电源系统，支持双路交流输入切换与多级低压脱扣保护。
shortDescEn: ZTE ZXDU68 T601 floor-standing -48V 600A telecom DC power cabinet featuring dual-AC input and comprehensive multi-stage LVD protection.
whatItIsZh: 该机柜作为大型电信通信局站与核心数据机房的主力动力源，支持并联多台 50A 高效整流模块，将高压市电稳定分配转换为 -48V 直流电，保障核心交换与传输设备永不断电。
whatItIsEn: Serving as the primary DC powerplant for central offices and data centers, this cabinet houses clusters of 50A rectifiers, converting utility power into secure -48V DC power for critical mission workloads.
problemSolvedZh: 解决大容量通信枢纽机房配电分散、占用面积大、多路电池难以统一智能化管理以及缺少大电流安全脱扣保护等瓶颈难题。
problemSolvedEn: Solves footprint sprawl and management complexity in massive telecom hubs by consolidating high-amperage AC/DC distribution and intelligent battery management into a single enclosure.
suitableForZh: 适用于 5G 核心网局房、省级枢纽通信大楼、大型移动数据中心、轨道交通调度中心以及跨国跨地域电信节点。
suitableForEn: Engineered for 5G core offices, regional carrier transmission hubs, hyperscale data centers, rail transit dispatch centers, and international gateways.
advantagesZh: 600A 强劲直流配电承载：单柜支持高达 600A 连续大电流输出，配备完善的双路交流互锁输入配电。
模块化自由平滑扩容：整流插框支持 N+1 冗余热插拔，可按需从 50A 弹性平滑扩容至 600A 满配置。
完备的二级低压脱扣管理：集成 LLVD（负载脱扣）与 BLVD（电池脱扣）双接触器，深度保护蓄电池组寿命。
电信级智能动环全面监控：标配 CSU401S 集中监控模块，支持全网远程 SNMP 遥信遥控与智能运维。
advantagesEn: 600A Heavy-Duty DC Busbar: Delivers up to 600A continuous output current with integrated dual-utility manual/automatic transfer switching.
Modular Elastic Expansion: Rectifier shelves support hitless N+1 hot-swap additions, scaling smoothly from 50A to 600A as site demand grows.
Advanced Dual-Stage LVD Protection: Houses independent LLVD (load shedding) and BLVD (battery protection) contactors to preserve battery integrity.
Carrier-Grade Comprehensive Monitoring: Features CSU401S central supervisor supporting remote SNMP telemetry, fault diagnosis, and automated battery tests.

faqsZh.q: ZXDU68 T601 机柜在交流两路进线同时有电时如何选择主备？
faqsZh.a: 系统配置双路交流输入断路器或交流切换单元（ATS），可通过手动互锁切换或自动优先检测机制锁定主路市电供电，主路失电时平滑转至油机或备用路。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 机柜报‘LLVD 接触器断开告警’意味着什么，如何恢复供电？
faqsZh.a: 表明由于长时间停电导致蓄电池放电至保护门限（如 44V），系统自动切除了一次非重要负载以延长重要业务运行。当市电恢复、母线电压回升至 48V 以上时，接触器将自动闭合复位。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 如何向机柜扩容新的整流模块？
faqsZh.a: 确认机架内整流空槽位防尘挡板取下后，直接将新的 ZXD3000/2400 模块顺着导轨推入底部锁定，模块将自动软启动并接入 CAN 均流总线，无需任何停机操作。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How does the ZXDU68 T601 manage primary and secondary AC mains inputs?
faqsEn.a: The cabinet incorporates mechanically interlocked input breakers or an automatic transfer switch (ATS) allowing priority utility feed selection, transferring safely to generator power upon primary outage. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: What does an 'LLVD Contactor Open' alarm signify, and how does it clear?
faqsEn.a: It indicates batteries have discharged down to the cutoff threshold (typically 44.0V), triggering load shedding of non-essential branches. Upon utility recovery, as DC bus voltage rises above 48.0V, the contactor re-closes automatically. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: What is the procedure for scaling up rectifier capacity in the cabinet?
faqsEn.a: Remove the blanking panel from an empty slot and slide the new ZXD3000/2400 rectifier module along the rails until latched. The unit automatically soft-starts and joins the active CAN load-sharing cluster without downtime. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

nameZh: 艾默生 Emerson PSM-212C23 通信电源系统智能监控模块 (RS485/CAN总线)
nameEn: Emerson PSM-212C23 Telecom Power System Intelligent Supervisory Controller (RS485/CAN)
directDefZh: 艾默生 PSM-212C23 是一款专为艾默生/维谛 NetSure 及高清通信电源系统研发的智能动环集中监控模块，具备全自动整流器协同调度与双重低压脱扣管理功能。
directDefEn: The Emerson PSM-212C23 is an intelligent central supervisory controller engineered for Emerson/Vertiv NetSure power systems, delivering automated rectifier coordination and dual low-voltage disconnect control.
shortDescZh: 艾默生 PSM-212C23 通信电源系统智能监控单元，具备液晶显示视窗、多路传感器接入与精准蓄电池充放电维护。
shortDescEn: Emerson PSM-212C23 telecom power supervisory unit featuring an LCD screen, sensor interfaces, and precise battery management.
whatItIsZh: 该模块安装于艾默生通信电源机框的中央插槽，负责实时监测交流配电、直流系统母线电量以及蓄电池运行环境，并控制整流器均浮充输出与接触器脱扣动作。
whatItIsEn: This controller occupies the central slot of Emerson telecom power subracks, auditing AC inputs, DC bus parameters, and battery bank health while regulating rectifier float levels and contactor states.
problemSolvedZh: 解决多模块缺乏统一电压调度、蓄电池欠充硫化或过充失水损坏、以及远程网管无法实时感知机房动力告警等运维难题。
problemSolvedEn: Solves lack of synchronized voltage regulation, prevents battery failure from undercharging or thermal runaway, and bridges field power plant telemetry to remote operations teams.
suitableForZh: 适用于艾默生 NetSure 系列嵌入式机框电源、各类 4G/5G 室内基站直流配电屏以及工业通信变电站直流监控改造。
suitableForEn: Engineered for Emerson NetSure embedded subracks, 4G/5G indoor telecom power plants, and industrial utility substation DC monitoring retrofits.
advantagesZh: 高可靠性工业级硬件架构：采用工业级嵌入式微处理器，抗强电磁干扰，在恶劣电气环境中长期不宕机。
先进的四阶段蓄电池管理：恒流充电、浮充、均充与智能温度补偿四位一体，大幅延长蓄电池组使用寿命。
完备的声光与干接点告警：面板配备清晰告警指示灯与蜂鸣器，提供多路可编程干接点供外部动环采集联动。
易于现场工程维护操作：配备带背光液晶显示屏与直观按键，现场巡检人员可无需电脑直接查看和调校参数。
advantagesEn: Industrial-Grade Hardware Architecture: Embedded processor engineered for high electromagnetic noise tolerance ensures non-stop uptime.
Advanced 4-Stage Battery Care: Integrates constant-current bulk, float, equalize, and thermal compensation charging to maximize battery lifespan.
Comprehensive Audio/Visual & Relay Alarms: Onboard status LEDs, audible buzzer, and programmable dry contacts facilitate site telemetry integration.
Field-Friendly Operation: Backlit LCD interface and intuitive keypad allow technicians to audit telemetry and adjust parameters without a laptop.

faqsZh.q: PSM-212C23 监控模块如何进行系统时间和日期校准？
faqsZh.a: 在主显示界面按‘确认’键进入菜单，选择‘系统设置’->‘时钟设置’，通过上下方向键调整年月日及精确时间后按确认键保存即可。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 监控单元持续报警提示‘温度传感器故障’，该如何排查？
faqsZh.a: 请检查连接至蓄电池组或机房的外部 NTC 温度传感器接线是否松动断开，使用万用表测量传感器在常温下的阻值（正常约为 10kΩ），若阻值异常请更换配套温度探头。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsZh.q: 模块在无操作一段时间后背光熄灭是否正常？
faqsZh.a: 属于正常节能保护机制。监控单元预设了按键背光超时休眠功能，任意按下操作面板上的任意按键即可重新唤醒背光。For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to calibrate the system date and time on the PSM-212C23 controller?
faqsEn.a: Press 'Enter' on the home screen to access the menu, navigate to 'System Settings' -> 'Clock Settings', adjust year, month, day, and time using arrow buttons, and press Enter to save. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: How to troubleshoot a persistent 'Temperature Sensor Fault' alarm?
faqsEn.a: Check the wiring harness connecting the external battery/shelter NTC sensor to the rear terminal block. Measure sensor resistance with a multimeter (nominal ~10kΩ at 25°C). Replace the probe if open or shorted. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.

faqsEn.q: Is it normal for the LCD backlight to turn off after a period of inactivity?
faqsEn.a: Yes. The controller incorporates an automatic power-saving backlight timer. Pressing any navigation key will immediately reactivate the illumination. For bench test verification, pinout diagrams, and custom warranty terms, contact our engineering desk via WhatsApp +86 17621197907.
